description: EPA describes observed and modelled demand variation in a city's water-distribution network. Excel and modelling metadata support a comparison of hydraulic behaviour and water age. This resource is provided by U.S. EPA Office of Research and Development (ORD). Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: EPA says the dataset is not publicly accessible because it includes personal and confidential network information. Access may require a legal arrangement with authorised users. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
